recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white square composition featuring a central water tower under a dramatic sky. The upper half is dominated by thick, dark clouds pierced by intense, diagonal crepuscular rays (god rays) that illuminate the scene. The lower half features a cylindrical water tower with a conical roof, set against a softer, cloudy horizon. A single line of clean, sans-serif text bisects the image horizontally.
coreVisualRelationships: The verticality of the water tower mirrors the downward diagonal path of the light rays.
The dark, heavy clouds at the top create a visual weight that is balanced by the solid structure of the tower below.
The horizontal text line acts as a bridge between the celestial light and the terrestrial structure.
coreInvariants: Strict monochrome palette with deep blacks and bright whites.
Central vertical alignment of the main subject.
Dramatic atmospheric lighting as the primary mood setter.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The water tower is centered in the lower two-thirds of the frame, appearing monumental against the sky.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The water tower's cylindrical body serves as the primary anchor, while the brightest point of the light rays serves as the secondary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bright light rays at the top, follows them down to the text line, and finally rests on the water tower and its structural details.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark, expansive sky on the left and right edges creates a sense of isolation and scale.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and black provide the foundation and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white is used for the light rays and the text to ensure maximum legibility and impact.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays define the textures of the clouds and the metallic surface of the tower.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; value is used to create depth and volume through extreme chiaroscuro.

letterConstructionRules: Capitals only for the main display line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Triple forward slashes (///) used as a rhythmic separator between text segments

composition.position: Center horizontal axis, slightly above the water tower
composition.scale: Small relative to the image width
composition.relationshipToImage: Floats over the sky, separating the light source from the subject

treatment.shadow: Subtle drop shadow for legibility against light rays

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying tracking and separators.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the clean, modern geometric look with balanced proportions.
A widely available geometric sans that handles wide tracking well.
Offers an industrial, technical feel that complements the water tower subject.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white photo of a rural water tower centered in the frame. The sky above should be dark and stormy, with dramatic crepuscular rays (god rays) breaking through the clouds in diagonal beams. The overall mood should be cinematic and slightly lonely.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of centered, all-caps sans-serif text across the middle of the image. Use wide tracking and separate the phrases with three forward slashes (///). Ensure the text is pure white with a very subtle outer glow or shadow to maintain legibility against the light rays.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Are the light rays clearly defined and diagonal?
Is the text centered and easy to read?
Is the water tower the primary terrestrial subject?

adjustableVariables: Height of the text line relative to the tower
mustRedesign: Any specific city names on the tower

mustAchieve: Dramatic tonal range from pure black to pure white
Sharp focus on the water tower structure

postGenerationChecks: Check for banding in the cloud gradients.
Ensure the text does not obscure critical details of the tower's roof.
Verify that the 'god rays' appear natural and not digitally over-processed.
Confirm the square aspect ratio is maintained.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Rural Subject + Dramatic Atmospheric Lighting + Wide-Tracked Geometric Sans-Serif Overlay.
